extra_quotes: Our representation-based support-assessment algorithm routes high-support configurations to teacher labelling to expand the student training set, while selected low-support configurations undergo DFT calculations to expand the teacher training set and update the teacher.
OMat24-pretrained DPA4-Neo and DPA4C-Nano provide the starting points for teacher and student fine-tuning, respectively 23–25.
Teachers and students are fine-tuned from OMat24-pretrained DPA4-Neo and DPA4C-Nano, respectively 23–25, using DeePMD-kit 42 with a 6 Å cutoff.
First-principles calculations are performed using the Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package (VASP) 44, with electron–ion interactions treated using the projector augmented-wave (PAW) method 45,46.
Support-guided routing depends on the teacher representations’ ability to distinguish relevant chemical environments and on the reference data used for comparison.
